name: info
content: Create a Vercel **Access Token** in [Account Settings → Tokens](https://vercel.com/account/tokens) and paste it below. To monitor a Team, also provide its **Team ID**; leave it blank to monitor your personal account.

name: accessToken
label: API Token
help: A Vercel Access Token. Sent as a bearer token on every request. Create one at [Account Settings → Tokens](https://vercel.com/account/tokens).

name: teamId
label: Team ID
help: Optional. The ID of the Vercel Team to monitor (found at Team Settings → General, format `team_…`). Leave blank to monitor your personal account.
